privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introduction: RuoYi-FastAPI takes your privacy seriously. This policy explains how we collect, use, store and protect your personal information. Please read it carefully before using the Product.
privacy.collectionTitle: 1. How we collect and use your personal information
privacy.collection: To provide better services, we may collect the following information:
privacy.account: • Account information: When you register or sign in, we collect information such as your username, password and phone number.
privacy.device: • Device information: To keep your account secure and improve our services, we collect your device model, operating system version and unique device identifier.
privacy.logs: • Log information: When you use the Product, we automatically collect activity logs, IP addresses and access times.
privacy.sharingTitle: 2. How we share, transfer or disclose your personal information
privacy.sharing: We do not share, transfer or publicly disclose your personal information to third parties, except:
privacy.consent: • With your explicit authorization or consent;
privacy.law: • As required by law, regulation or judicial authorities;
privacy.publicInterest: • To protect national security, public safety or significant public interests.
privacy.securityTitle: 3. How we protect your personal information
privacy.security: We use security measures including data encryption, access controls and security audits to protect your personal information. We work to prevent unauthorized access, alteration or disclosure.
privacy.rights: You have the right to access, correct or delete your personal information. You may also close your account at any time. To exercise these rights, contact us using the details in the Contact us section.
privacy.updates: We may update this policy as laws, regulations or our business change. Updated policies will be published in the Product, and we will notify you appropriately before they take effect.
